user.title: Server connection
user.description: Enter the DOODS2 base URL and optional API key. On submit, DOOODS checks GET /detectors and loads the configured detector and label choices before continuing.

data_description.url: Use the app's internal hostname and port, for example http://addon-hostname:8080. Do not add /detect.
data_description.auth_key: The key is sent in the doods-auth-key header. The current DOODS2 server does not enforce it, so do not rely on it for protection.

cameras.title: Cameras and schedule
cameras.description: Choose cameras and a periodic fallback interval. You can assign an existing motion sensor to each camera on the next screen.

data_description.source: Select one or more camera entities to scan.
data_description.scan_interval: Periodic fallback interval between scans of each camera, in seconds.

detection.title: Detector and defaults
detection.description: Select a configured detector and set timeout and confidence defaults for camera scans.

data_description.detector: Select one detector reported by the DOODS2 server.
data_description.timeout: Timeout applied to camera snapshots and DOODS2 requests.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Choose labels to track. Leaving the selection empty tracks every label reported by the detector.

data_description.labels: Select one or more reported labels. If the server does not report labels, enter one label per line. All selected labels use the global confidence and area.

area.title: Global detection area
area.description: Set the shared area applied to every camera detection. Coordinates are normalized from 0 to 1.

area.name: Global detection area
area.description: The defaults cover the full image.

data.covers: Require each detection to fit fully inside the area

data_description.covers: When disabled, any overlap with the area is enough.

output.title: Annotated frame archive
output.description: Only frames with at least one detection that passes the active filters are stored. Leave the directory empty to disable the archive.

data.archive_max_age_days: Maximum frame age in days (0 = unlimited)

data_description.file_out: Enter one archive root directory. Relative paths are resolved under the Home Assistant configuration directory. DOOODS creates entry, camera, and date subdirectories and writes uniquely named JPEG files. Previous multi-line path templates were not used; replace them with a single directory. Cleanup only touches files created inside this entry archive. Changing or clearing the directory does not delete an older archive.
data_description.archive_max_count: When a new frame is stored, the oldest files for that camera are removed until the count is within this limit.
data_description.archive_max_age_days: Expired files are cleaned on startup, daily, and when frames are stored. If both limits are set, exceeding either one removes the file.

reconfigure.title: Change DOOODS connection settings
reconfigure.description: Update the saved URL or API key. DOOODS checks GET /detectors and requires at least one configured detector before saving.

data_description.url: Use the app's internal hostname and port, for example http://addon-hostname:8080. Do not add /detect.
data_description.auth_key: The current value is shown as a masked field. Saving an empty value clears the key. The current DOODS2 server does not enforce this key.

motion.title: Motion trigger
motion.description: Camera {camera_name} ({camera_entity_id}), {camera_index} of {camera_count}. If exactly one motion sensor is linked to the camera device, DOOODS selects it automatically. If several are linked, choose one. If none are linked, choose an external binary_sensor. Periodic scanning remains as a fallback.

data_description.motion_sensor: Motion sensors linked to the camera device are preferred. Choose an external binary_sensor if the camera has no motion sensor.

profiles.title: Camera detection profile
profiles.description: Camera {camera_name} ({camera_entity_id}), {camera_index} of {camera_count}. Select a saved Overhaul profile. Its polygon zones and per-zone label thresholds replace the integration-wide label, confidence, and rectangular-area filters for this camera. Choose no profile to keep the existing filters.

data_description.profile_id: A selected profile controls accepted labels, confidence thresholds, and polygon zones for this camera.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS base URL without credentials, query, or fragment.
error.already_configured: A DOOODS entry already uses this server URL.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the DOODS2 server or GET /detectors returned an error.
error.invalid_auth: The DOODS2 server rejected the API key.
error.invalid_response: The server replied, but the /detectors response is not valid.
error.no_detectors: The server did not report any configured detectors.
error.detector_not_found: The previously selected detector is no longer available. Select a replacement.
error.no_cameras: Select at least one camera entity.

abort.already_configured: This DOODS2 server is already configured in DOOODS.

scan.name: Scan cameras now
scan.description: Queue an immediate scan for the selected camera or cameras. The request is independent of the periodic schedule and motion sensors, and the action does not wait for completion.
